tools.name: assess_broken_app
tools.description: Triage a problem in a live app built with an AI app builder (Lovable, Base44, Bolt, Replit, v0 or similar). The most common one: new people can't sign up. The confirmation email never arrives, its link opens localhost or the preview, sign-up loops back or shows an error, or Google sign-in fails. It

tools.name: get_fix_options
tools.description: Returns the link to a sign-up check of a live app on vibe-fixer.com. An AI agent signs up as a brand-new person with a real inbox, on a phone and a computer, and reports whether a new person can finish signing up, plus anything else a first customer would hit. It also says how the fix works and what

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the apps connected to the signed-in person's VibeFix account, with the status of each. Call this when they ask what VibeFix is working on, which of their apps are connected, or before checking on a specific repair.

tools.name: check_repair_status
tools.description: Report the current state of one project on the signed-in VibeFix account: whether a repair is running, waiting for their approval, or finished. Use the project id from list_projects.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assess_broken_app, get_fix_options · Private data: get_fix_options · Public sink: assess_broken_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assess_broken_app, get_fix_options · Private data: get_fix_options · Public sink: assess_broken_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assess_broken_app" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
